title: Picking things with the mouse
description:
Find which 3D object a ray from the camera hits first.

```
ray from (0, 1, 5) towards -Z
sphere at (0, 1, 0) r 1 -> hit at distance 4
box (2..3, 0..2, -1..1)  -> miss
closest hit: the sphere
```
hints: With `m = o - c`, solve `t² + 2(m·d)t + (m·m - r²) = 0` for a unit `d`; the smaller non-negative root is the hit (lesson 5.03).
Slab method: for each axis, `t1 = (min - o) / d`, `t2 = (max - o) / d`; the ray hits when the largest of the near values is at most the smallest of the far ones.
requirements: `raySphere(origin, dir, centre, radius)` returns the distance or nothing.
`rayBox(origin, dir, min, max)` with the "slab" method.
Pick the closest hit among a list of objects.
stretch: Build the ray from the mouse position, as `GetMouseRay` does.
